required_scopes: Look up a video by its title
Look up a video by a fingerprint of its file (separate permission, off by default)

intro.title: Stash-box lookup
intro.summary: Details, covers, performers and studios for videos in your Vault, from StashDB. Stash-box is a kind of community video database; StashDB (stashdb.org) is the public one, and you can add another stash-box server. Library asks it only about videos in your Vault. You need your own free StashDB account: the key is kept on this machine and sent only to stashdb.org so it knows the request is yours; the video's title is sent to find a match; a fingerprint of the file only if you switch that on. Without a key, nothing is sent.

skip_consequences.summary: Vault videos keep the title from their file name and a still frame as the cover.

credentials.label: Stash-box account key
credentials.format_hint: The API key from your account on the stash-box server. It is sent in an ApiKey header to that server only.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Stash-box videos are looked up on these servers, in this order. StashDB is the public one; you can add another stash-box server.

fingerprint_permission.title: Send a fingerprint of your file
fingerprint_permission.description: Off by default. A short fingerprint of the video file helps StashDB find an exact match; the file itself is never sent.

language_strategy.title: Language
language_strategy.description: Which language the source's details come in.

timeout_seconds.title: Request timeout
timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the source before giving up.

throttle_ms.title: Minimum request interval
throttle_ms.description: The shortest wait between two requests.

max_concurrency.title: Most requests at once
max_concurrency.description: How many requests may be waiting for the source at the same time.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: How much Library trusts this source when two disagree. Set by Library.

requests_per_second.title: Rate limit
requests_per_second.description: The most requests a second Library makes to this source.

cache_ttl_hours.title: Cache time
cache_ttl_hours.description: How long an answer is kept before the source is asked again.

ui_metadata.short_description: Finds Vault videos on StashDB and fills in details, covers and performers.

declaration.changelog: First built-in version: the Vault's own source for video details.
